Subject: QBR pipeline sweep: account-by-account vet & final forecast tie-out

Sarah —

Hope you’re well. As we head into QBR prep we want to run a quick, account-level vet of our pipeline with you to make sure the forecast numbers align before the exec readout. Specifically we want to confirm:

- Contract timing (expected signature month)
- Typical deployment start / first invoice date
- Any outstanding security/compliance gating items that could shift delivery

Can we do a 25-minute sync next week? My proposed times: Tue 8/11 10:00am PT or Wed 8/12 2:00pm PT. If neither works, send a time that does. I’ll bring the one-pager and the consolidated forecast workbook.

Attachments: Acme_account_onepager.pdf (one-pager), forecast_consolidation_ACME.xlsx (current numbers)

Thanks,
Sean

Sean — quick note before the sync with Acme. A couple of things to prep on our side so the meeting is a clean tie-out:

- Pull the last committed forecast vs. AC (actual committed) columns in the workbook and highlight any delta > 15%.
- Have the roadmap for Dedicated capacity delivery (lead time = 6 weeks) ready in case they push the start date.
- Markus — flag any known pricing exceptions or approved credits that we should disclose during the call.
- Laura — bring the renewal cadence language; Sarah has previously asked about billing alignment with their fiscal month.

I’ll draft a two-slide QBR appendix we can drop into the exec packet after the call.

Tessa

Sean / team —

Thanks for the note and for putting the workbook together. Wed 8/12 at 2:00pm PT works for us. High level from our side:

- We still plan to sign in September but pushing to late-September is possible depending on a couple of procurement approvals (two-week risk).
- No new security blockers; our InfoSec asked a couple of clarifying questions about data retention and audit logs. I’ll bring our Sales Ops lead to the sync to confirm billing cadence.
- We want to confirm whether Dedicated capacity can be staged to reduce initial spend and then ramp to full reserved capacity post-signature.

Agenda for the call: 1) Forecast numbers tie-out, 2) Procurement timing & gating, 3) Deployment cadence options.

Sarah Jones
Director of Platform Partnerships | Acme Corp

Subject: Re: QBR pipeline sweep: account-by-account vet & final forecast tie-out — post-call summary and ask

Team —

Recap from today’s 2:00pm PT sync with Acme (Sarah + Sales Ops):

1) Signed timing: Acme intends to sign in September; practical window is Sep 20–30 (two-week procurement swing).
2) Forecast delta: our consolidated workbook shows a $250k delta vs. the last committed number (they are backing some MSAs to go from full reserved to staged Dedicated). I updated the spreadsheet (tab: "ACME_tieout_0815") and flagged the cells.
3) Delivery gating: no InfoSec blockers — only a standard audit-log clarification which engineering has confirmed is supported.
4) Commercial ask: they requested the option for a 3-month staged Dedicated onboarding with prorated billing for the ramp period. They asked for a short term credit/discount conversation.

Immediate asks:
- Markus: recommend approved credit range or alternative structuring (term + ramp pricing) we can present to Acme by EOD tomorrow.
- Aditya: if Legal needs to pre-draft an amendment for staged capacity, can you scope a minimal change template (billing schedule + effective date) — low-touch.
- Laura/Tessa: I’ll need a one-slide appendix for the QBR deck (due Friday) — slide should include: final committed ARR, expected signature window, risks (procurement swing + credit request), and recommended next-step owner.

Attachments: updated forecast_consolidation_ACME.xlsx (tab: ACME_tieout_0815), Acme_account_onepager.pdf

Thanks — I’ll loop Sarah once we have proposed commercial structuring.

Sean
